acceptance: A hosted `@slow` or `@plan` oracle review through the gateway completes, with its longest silent stretch measured from the gateway log, or a reproducible failure is recorded with its cause.
If silent stretches past the idle limit fail, the gateway or reviewer setting is changed and the fix verified the same way.
description: Once PR #3296 moves the reviewer onto the scoped auth-gateway, every reviewer request streams through `omp auth-gateway serve` on the owner's Mac. The local test of that setup did not include a request with a long silent stretch. The gateway runs on Bun, whose server idle timeout is at most 255 seconds; the gateway's setting and its keepalive behaviour during provider silence were not checked. A high-effort `@slow` or `@plan` review can think longer than that before emitting output, so long reviews could fail as absent. Start after #3296 merges.
